patches: Lattice-based cryptography, NIST PQC standards, quantum-safe payments,[^<]+

Kiripitoggirafi bisa lattice, ƙa'idojin NIST PQC, biyan kuɗi mai jure kwantam da barazanar "tattara yanzu, warware daga baya". Rubuce-rubucen bincike, ɗakunan karatu na buɗaɗɗen tushe da jagororin ƙaura ga ƙungiyoyin tsaro na hidimomin kuɗi.
Ƙaurar saƙonni tsakanin ƙasashe, bin ƙa'idar adireshi mai tsari, SEPA Instant, SWIFT gpi da manyan hanyoyin biyan kuɗi da suke ɗauke da komai. Kayan aiki, jagora da jadawalin tsari.

AI mai ƙirƙira, LLM masu hanyoyi da yawa, murya da samfuran magana — da yadda suke sake tsara ayyukan banki, hidimar abokan ciniki da injiniyancin samfura a manyan cibiyoyi.

Ɗakunan karatu na Rust na buɗaɗɗen tushe da nake rubutawa da kula da su: shiga rajista, ƙirƙirar kod, kwanan wata da lokaci, tushen kiripitoggirafi, KEM bisa Kyber da wani janareta na shafukan tsaye da aka rubuta da Rust.

title="Visit the Emerging Payments Association Asia"

>A system for real-time speech-to-text transcription that leverages OpenAI Whisper and Metal Performance Shaders GPU acceleration on macOS to achieve sub-second latency at 8-12x real-time on M1 Max\.<

>Tsarin juyar da magana zuwa rubutu a lokaci guda wanda ke amfani da OpenAI Whisper da haɓakar GPU ta Metal Performance Shaders a macOS domin samun jinkiri ƙasa da daƙiƙa ɗaya, sau 8–12 na ainihin lokaci a M1 Max.<
>A new paper suggests Shor\'s algorithm could run on as few as 10,000 qubits\. The threshold for cryptographically relevant quantum computing is dropping fast\.<
>Sabon takarda ya nuna cewa algorithm ɗin Shor na iya gudana da ƙwayoyin ƙubit 10,000 kacal. Matakin lissafin kwantam mai muhimmanci ga kiripitoggirafi yana saukowa da sauri.<
>A bug in Yilei Chen's quantum algorithm for solving LWE has been found, temporarily securing lattice-based cryptography and highlighting the need for ongoing research\.<
>An gano kuskure a cikin algorithm ɗin kwantam na Yilei Chen na warware LWE, wanda ya tsare kiripitoggirafi bisa lattice na ɗan lokaci tare da nuna buƙatar ci gaba da bincike.<
>New quantum algorithm solves a key cryptographic problem, urging accelerated research into quantum-safe security\.<
>Sabon algorithm ɗin kwantam ya warware wata muhimmiyar matsalar kiripitoggirafi, yana kira da a gaggauta bincike kan tsaro mai jure kwantam.<
>How Fully Homomorphic Encryption revolutionises data security in banking and financial services, preserving privacy against quantum-era threats\.<
>Yadda cikakken ɓoye-bayanai na homomorphic ke kawo sauyi ga tsaron bayanai a banki da hidimomin kuɗi, yana kiyaye sirri gaban barazanar zamanin kwantam.<
>An analysis of Apple's MM1 paper on Multimodal Large Language Models — architecture, pre-training strategies and emerging capabilities\.<
>Nazarin takardar MM1 ta Apple kan manyan samfuran harshe masu hanyoyi da yawa — gine-gine, dabarun horo na farko da sabbin iyawa.<
>How IBM Qiskit and the Quantum Fourier Transform reshape credit ratio analysis in finance, offering unprecedented accuracy and speed\.<
>Yadda IBM Qiskit da juyawar Fourier ta kwantam ke sake tsara nazarin rabon bashi a fannin kuɗi, tare da daidaito da gudu da ba a taɓa gani ba.<
>The transformative role of AI inside quantum algorithms for finance, focusing on their mathematical structure and banking applications\.<
>Muhimmiyar rawar AI a cikin algorithms na kwantam don fannin kuɗi, tare da mai da hankali kan tsarinsu na lissafi da amfaninsu a banki.<
>As quantum computers threaten traditional encryption, Quantum Key Distribution \(QKD\) emerges as a structural answer for financial-grade security\.<
>Yayin da kwamfutocin kwantam ke barazana ga ɓoye-bayanai na gargajiya, rarraba maɓalli ta kwantam (QKD) na fitowa a matsayin amsa mai tushe ga tsaro na matakin kuɗi.<
>How CRYSTALS-Kyber, the NIST-selected quantum-resistant key-encapsulation mechanism, is reshaping cryptography for the quantum era\.<
>Yadda CRYSTALS-Kyber, tsarin ɗaure maɓalli mai jure kwantam da NIST ta zaɓa, ke sake tsara kiripitoggirafi na zamanin kwantam.<

(<summary[^>]*>Wane irin bincike da wallafe-wallafe kuke fitarwa\?</summary>)\s*<section class="qa-a">[\s\S]*?</section>

\1

Akwai hanyoyi biyu da suke tafiya tare. Takardun farare na masana'antu, waɗanda ake yi wa ƙungiyoyi kamar Emerging Payments Association Asia (EPAA), suna nazarin sauye-sauyen tsari a kayan more rayuwa na biyan kuɗi — kwanan nan tasirin lissafin kwantam mai muhimmanci ga kiripitoggirafi kan hanyoyin sasantawa na manyan biyan kuɗi da na lokaci guda. Rahotannin bincike da aka yi amfani da su suna mai da hankali kan takamaiman batutuwan fasaha (misali: gane magana a lokaci guda da Whisper + Metal Performance Shaders a Apple Silicon) kuma ana fitar da su a matsayin PDF da ake sayan kowanne shi kaɗai.
>Quantum-Safe Payments: Why the Payments Industry Must Act Now<
>Biyan kuɗi mai jure kwantam: dalilin da ya sa masana'antar biyan kuɗi dole ta ɗauki mataki yanzu<
>Accelerating Real-Time Speech Recognition with OpenAI Whisper and Metal Performance Shaders on macOS<
>Haɓaka gane magana a lokaci guda da OpenAI Whisper da Metal Performance Shaders a macOS<

>Lissafin kwantam yana barazana ga tushen kiripitoggirafi na hidimomin kuɗi. Biyan kuɗi — daga lokaci guda zuwa sasantawa tsakanin ƙasashe — yana dogara ne kan kariyar da lissafin kwantam zai ƙarasa mayar da wofi. Wannan takardar EPAA ta bayyana dalilin da ya sa masana'antar dole ta ɗauki mataki yanzu.

Ana iya sauke takardar EPAA Quantum-Safe Payments kyauta kuma a bainar jama'a daga emergingpaymentsasia.org. Rahoton bincike mai zaman kansa kan gane magana a lokaci guda da OpenAI Whisper da Metal Performance Shaders yana da lasisi kuma ana iya sayan sa shi kaɗai kan $49.00 (Turanci, PDF, ~95 KB). Kwafi ɗaya ga kowane mai saya; saukewa don amfanin kai kaɗai, ba a sake rarrabawa.

Ga rahotannin bincike masu zaman kansu, a ambata haka: Rousseau, S. (shekara). Take. An buga da kai. tare da adireshin canonical. Domin sake buga wani zane ko doguwar sashe, a tuntuɓe ni tukun.
(<summary[^>]*>Ga wa aka nufi waɗannan wallafe-wallafe\?</summary>)\s*<section class="qa-a">[\s\S]*?</section>

\1

Daraktocin biyan kuɗi, CISO da manyan masu tsara tsarin fasaha a manyan bankuna, bankunan tsakiya, masu gudanar da tsarin biyan kuɗi da masu mallakar tsare-tsare. Binciken da aka yi amfani da shi yana nufin injiniyoyi da masu kula da samfura da ke gina kan manyan samfuran harshe, AI a kan na'ura da kiripitoggirafi mai jure kwantam. Kowace takarda tana ɗaukan sanin fannin kuma tana barin bayanan da ƙwararre mai aiki ya riga ya sani.
(<summary[^>]*>Zan iya ba da odar bincike ko gayyata zuwa taro\?</summary>)\s*<section class="qa-a">[\s\S]*?</section>

\1

Ee — kowane hali a kansa, bisa zaɓi. Ayyukan oda suna kan manyan biyan kuɗi, ƙaurar ISO 20022, kiripitoggirafi bayan-kwantam ga hidimomin kuɗi da AI da aka yi amfani da shi a banki. Ana duba jawabai a taron masana'antu, dandalin bankunan tsakiya da teburin tattaunawa na masu tsara doka kowanne shi kaɗai. Yi amfani da fom ɗin tuntuɓa, tare da bayyana batun, masu sauraro da jadawali.
